claim: Le Bois Dormant has 15 rooms (12 in Grande Maison + 3 in Maison des Kakis), Relais & Châteaux 5-star, rooms from €300 without breakfast.
quote: The property offers 15 rooms across two buildings. The Grande Maison contains 12 guest rooms, while the former wine press (Maison des Kakis) houses 3 additional rooms. Budget €300/night without breakfast.

claim: Le Pré Cheval offers three gîtes priced €220–320/night with a €25/pp Troisgros breakfast basket on reservation.
quote: Petit Pied-à-terre 220€ per night… Grand Pied-à-terre 320€ per night… breakfast basket from Troisgros 25€ per person on reservation.

claim: Domaine Bérenguer has 3 rooms at €130/night (breakfast included), 1 km from Troisgros, Gîtes de France certified since 2021.
quote: 3 bedrooms… €130 per night (base 2 people)… breakfast included… Le restaurant gastronomique 3 étoiles Troisgros est à 1 km.

claim: Domaine d'Aromm has 5 rooms €125–165/night with breakfast included, ~10–15 min walk to Troisgros, on 27 ha with pool and ponds.
quote: less than 15 min on foot… a small digestive walk in our beautiful Roannaise nature… 27 hectares of grounds with two ponds.

claim: Château d'Origny is a 5-suite B&B in Ouches offering free return transportation to La Maison Troisgros restaurant.
quote: Château d'Origny offers free return transportation to La Maison Troisgros restaurant in Ouches.

claim: Le Bois Dormant is closed Dec 22 2025 – Jan 14 2026; breakfast costs €40 per person; check-in 4 pm, check-out 11 am; sits on a 17-hectare estate at 728 Route de Villerest, Ouches.
quote: Breakfast costs €40 per person… Check-in: 4 p.m. | Check-out: 11 a.m. … 17-hectare estate.

claim: Average official price for a double room at Maison Troisgros (with breakfast) is €510.
quote: The average official price for a double room including breakfast is €510.

claim: Maison Troisgros hotel is rated 4.6/5 across 375 TripAdvisor reviews, holds Travellers' Choice, with guests reporting no local taxis and limited Uber service.
quote: 375 total reviews, 4.6/5 rating… a taxi was specially arranged, as there are no taxis and limited Uber service in the area.

claim: Le Pré Cheval is Marion Troisgros's farm a few minutes' walk from Domaine de Ouches and operates as a separate establishment from Maison Troisgros.
quote: Le Pré Cheval is located just a few minutes' walk from the Domaine de Ouches… These are two separate establishments.

claim: Le Pré Cheval has 5 bedrooms with total capacity of 17 people, at 1005 route de Villerest, 42155 Ouches; closed Mondays and Tuesdays.
quote: 5 Bedroom(s)… 17 Person(s) maximum occupancy… 1005 route de Villerest, 42155 Ouches… Closed on monday, on tuesday.

claim: Château d'Origny is a 16th-century property near Roanne with two helicopter pads, suite rooms and a gourmet restaurant; chef Julien Laval holds a Michelin star since 2023.
quote: 16th-century property near Roanne with two private helicopter pads… Michelin-starred dinner.

claim: Château d'Origny B&B is ranked #1 of 2 B&Bs in Ouches at 4/5 across 131 reviews; observed rate around $187/night.
quote: 131 verified traveler reviews… ranked #1 of 2 B&Bs/inns in Ouches and rated 4 of 5… CHATEAU D'ORIGNY CHAMBRES D'HOTES ET RESTAURANT $187.

claim: Domaine d'Aromm is an equestrian chambre d'hôtes in Ouches with a heated pool, two ponds and walking access to Troisgros through Roannaise countryside.
quote: guests can walk to dinner at Troisgros… The environment is calm and perfect for relaxation with several ponds, horses, sheep, and geese.
